activation_gate.decision: Do not download, run, fine-tune, screen, promote, or compare Novae in v1.
activation_gate.minimum_future_evidence: An authoritative, rights-cleared donor-level spatial RNA dataset with reusable counts, coordinates, section and participant joins, outcome-independent tissue boundaries, adequate donor power, and permission for checkpoint use and any derivative-weight release.
activation_gate.task_gate: Register a spatial endpoint, donor-level inferential unit, transcript-native mandatory baselines, strict frozen and native-transductive lanes, prospective power, and a genuinely external source before any superiority or champion claim.

checkpoint_training_corpus.reason: Published Supplementary Data declare liver context and do not declare MASLD supervision, but the exact checkpoint lacks a bound accession, donor-alias, and source-version manifest.

gse192741.biological_units: 4 donors represented by 5 Visium sections; one donor contributes 2 sections
gse192741.chronology: The source predates the 2024 checkpoint blobs, and a donor or accession alias crosswalk to the 78 declared samples is not frozen.
gse192741.modality_transfer: Visium is spatial RNA but is a lower-resolution spot assay than the image-based single-cell pretraining corpus.
gse192741.why: Four donors, exposed outcomes, unresolved hg19 annotation identity, and cross-resolution transfer permit only future technical diagnostics. HEST-1k copies are duplicates, not new donors.

gse292268.biological_units: 4 F2 MASLD donors distributed two per CosMx slide
gse292268.modality_transfer: CosMx matches a declared pretraining platform, but target slide and donor joins remain unresolved.
gse292268.why: The slide, field-of-view, and region-to-donor map is unresolved; four donors cannot support superiority; morphology is unavailable.

hra007511.modality_transfer: Visium RNA is cross-resolution. H&E and MALDI are not inputs to the registered transcriptomic checkpoint.
hra007511.why: Spatial and image assets require permission, derivative-weight rights require written approval, participant joins are not admitted, and source findings are already project-exposed.

vu2025.biological_units: 33 biopsies from 32 participants; one participant has two synchronous cores
vu2025.modality_transfer: Visium RNA is cross-resolution. CODEX and H&E are not native features of the registered checkpoint.
vu2025.topology: Ten VLP technical arrays each contain four to five participants; barcode, tissue-island, core, and participant boundaries are unresolved.
vu2025.why: A data-sharing agreement is required, graphs would otherwise cross participants, and CODEX registration is incomplete.

strict_frozen_lane.encoder: Use the exact frozen transcriptomic checkpoint only after weight terms and safe loading clear.
strict_frozen_lane.feature_policy: Disable target-fit HVG discovery and freeze identifiers, vocabulary intersection, feature selection, and any transferable scaling from development donors.
strict_frozen_lane.query_normalization: If per-slide normalization or z-scoring remains inseparable from the native representation, label the lane transductive at the preprocessing level and do not call it strict donor-inductive.
strict_frozen_lane.graph: Construct an outcome-blind graph independently within each held participant, core, and section using a development-locked rule.
strict_frozen_lane.head_and_prototypes: Fit the task head, prototypes, hierarchy, clustering resolution, domain mapping, calibration, and thresholds using development donors only. Never refit them on a held cohort.
strict_frozen_lane.inference: Encode each held donor without access to other held donors' features and without reference='all'.

native_transductive_lane.zero_shot_behavior: The official zero_shot=True path recomputes K-means prototypes from selected query or reference latent features and overwrites prototype assignments.
native_transductive_lane.reference_all: reference='all' pools features across the evaluation cohort and is cross-donor transduction.
native_transductive_lane.target_feature_fit: Automatic HVGs and slide gene statistics may use all target nodes.
native_transductive_lane.reporting: Report this lane separately as native transductive inference. Do not use its results as evidence that the checkpoint generalizes inductively to unseen donors.
native_transductive_lane.fine_tuning: Any query fine-tuning is a still stronger query-adaptive lane and receives a new artifact identity.

donor_and_graph_firewall.multiple_samples: All sections, cores, aliquots, fields of view, slides, arrays, and graphs from one participant remain in one outer fold.
donor_and_graph_firewall.technical_units: Cells, spots, nodes, fields, sections, arrays, edges, leaves, and prototypes are not biological replicates.
donor_and_graph_firewall.graph_scope: Never construct a graph across donor, participant, core, section, tissue-island, field, slide, or capture-array boundaries unless a prespecified same-participant registered-volume design explicitly authorizes a boundary.
donor_and_graph_firewall.physical_distance: Freeze coordinate source, units, scale-to-microns, and radius. Delaunay without a radius must not bridge disconnected tissue islands.
donor_and_graph_firewall.uncertainty: Resample donors or participants for inferential uncertainty.

modality_and_missingness.H&E: The registered checkpoint is transcriptomic. A future same-section H&E composite requires exact image weights, development-fit PCA, registration, terms, and a new checkpoint manifest.
modality_and_missingness.CODEX: Protein observations cannot be entered as expression genes or paired node features without a separately specified assay-native extension.
modality_and_missingness.MALDI: Adjacent-section metabolite intensities are not same-cell expression and are not native Novae inputs.
modality_and_missingness.RNA_ATAC: Novae does not natively implement the benchmark's same-nucleus RNA-conditioned ATAC prediction endpoint.
modality_and_missingness.missingness: Use observed, structurally_missing, not_applicable, below_qc, unavailable_permission, join_unresolved, withheld_sealed, and derivable_not_processed. Never encode an unavailable modality, gene panel, registration, or donor join as zero.

claim_boundary.possible_future_role: Frozen spatial-RNA representation or domain comparator on a powered donor-resolved spatial endpoint, alongside spot-native and graph-native baselines.
claim_boundary.prohibited: v1 training, screening, leaderboard rank, MASLD spatial champion, superiority, multimodal H&E or CODEX claim, or a claim of strict zero-shot donor transfer from the native prototype-refit path
claim_boundary.clinical: No diagnostic, prognostic, treatment-response, or deployment claim.

interpretation: Novae is the only one of these three deferred methods with a canonical public pretrained spatial-transcriptomic checkpoint, but that does not make it ready for the campaign. Its weights lack declared terms; the corpus has definite liver encoder exposure but no checkpoint-bound accession receipt; native zero-shot refits query prototypes; and current MASLD spatial sources are small, controlled, exposed, join-unresolved, or cross-resolution. It remains deferred with no v1 task or champion eligibility.
